# python-1.26.0

## What Changed

Added agent framework core : Expose loop return final only on create harness agent() so non streaming callers can request only the final loop response without changing the existing default or streaming behavior ( 10214) agent framework core : Add the optional experimental SecureAgentConfig.message labeler callback for application owned classification of context provider messages ( 9876) agent framework github copilot : Support Pydantic models and JSON Schema mappings through response format , including parsed response values in streaming and non streaming runs ( 9810) samples : Add task scoped authority middleware guidance and an executable example ( 10215) Changed agent framework github copilot : [BREAKING] Require GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.85 or later and fail startup when its version is older or cannot be determined ( 10156) Migration: Upgrade custom runtimes selected by cli path , GITHUB COPILOT CLI PATH , or COPILOT CLI PATH to CLI 1.0.85 or later. Default SDK installations already meet this minimum: the existing SDK floor, 1.0.16, bundles CLI 1.0.90.
